= Client-side

Client-side JavaScript frameworks, organized by category.

* https://perf-track.web.app/[Perf Track]

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/frameworks/client-side/component-based/index.adoc[Component-based]* \
  Component-based JavaScript frameworks. The major frameworks each have their own
  page below; other, less common ones are listed directly.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/frameworks/client-side/html-based/index.adoc[HTML-based]* \
  Frameworks that extend plain HTML with reactive behaviour, rather than requiring
  a JavaScript-first component model.
